feature: Auto-login after set-password via signup-exchange token (Git #636, Epic: A. Core Assessment Product)
notes: HONESTY CAVEAT — same architectural wall as #987's money-path-e2e.json: a signupExchangeTokensTable token is minted ONLY inside POST /public/flow/set-password, which itself requires a real Stripe-paid checkout session (and, for a first-time buyer, the earlier Microsoft admin-consent OAuth callback that provisions the users row). Neither is drivable by BuildConsole's WebView2 + HTTP harness, so a genuine mint -> exchange -> real-session round trip cannot be fabricated here. What this manifest DOES cover honestly: /auth/signup-exchange's real guard behavior for a missing/invalid/expired/already-used token — the same negative-path shape print-exchange/document-print-exchange/impersonate-exchange all share, and the only part of this endpoint reachable without the payment+consent wall.

shaneapp://runTest couriers to the DEPLOYED BuildConsole/api-server instance, not this session's uncommitted worktree code — see the buildconsole-runtest memory. RAN at commit 2d53fbb2: 0/2 passed, both 404 Cannot POST /api/auth/signup-exchange — the route, the set-password token-mint, and the new signup_exchange_tokens table did not exist yet in the deployed build/DB at that time (the manual migration is a Shane To-Do). This is the expected, honest result for undeployed code, not a guard-logic defect; re-run after Shane deploys and runs the migration to get a real green.
